name: TrueTeacher Synthetic Dataset
description: TrueTeacher is a large-scale synthetic dataset generated by annotating diverse model-generated summaries using a large language model to improve factual consistency evaluation. It enables training student models that outperform existing state-of-the-art models and generalizes well across domains and multilingual scenarios.
reputation: A useful synthetic training/evaluation resource for factual consistency that has been cited for improving summary evaluation models, but it is not yet a broadly standardized benchmark.
notes: Dataset is multilingual and generated without relying on human-written summaries; enables robust and domain-shift resistant factual consistency evaluation.
